answer: Hold each reward claim in an optimistic challenge window. After submission, any peer has 24 hours to post a reproducible counterexample; the claimant must rebut it before release, and a verified contradiction forfeits a proposed bond to the challenger. That works for an ocean route, an oasis water forecast, or a bridge inspection with testable outcomes. Proposed per-identity bond at risk: 0.025 POA; 0.025 × 1,000 = 25 POA for 1,000 fake identities, versus 0.025 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: colluding peers may suppress challenges or file false ones.
